experiences.title: Backend Web Developer
experiences.description:
Develop and maintain Laravel backend systems for internal and client-facing platforms.
Design and implement REST API integrations between Laravel, WordPress, and WooCommerce systems.
Build data synchronization for orders, product pricing, inventory, and property information.
Develop custom Drupal modules, structured content, and Paragraph-based forms.
Expose structured Drupal content through JSON:API for headless CMS implementations.
Collaborate with project managers and developers across Malta and the Philippines.
Write maintainable code and support ongoing improvements to CMS-based websites and custom applications.

projects.title: E-Commerce Synchronization Platform
projects.description: Built a Laravel REST API integration to synchronize orders, product prices, and inventory between WooCommerce and a client’s internal inventory system. Developed a multi-tenant version of the integration platform.

projects.title: Estate Agency Platform
projects.description: Built a Laravel REST API integration to synchronize real estate property data from a client’s internal CMS to a WordPress frontend. Developed a multi-tenant version of the platform.

projects.title: Drupal-Based Headless CMS
projects.description: Developed custom Drupal modules and content types, created Paragraph-based forms, and exposed structured content through JSON:API. Worked with a headless CMS architecture in which Drupal manages content and a Next.js frontend handles presentation.
